create.name: Carol Krucoff
create.bio:
Carol Krucoff is an American yoga teacher and certified yoga therapist who has practised yoga for more than fifty years and now specialises in teaching people in midlife and later life. With Kimberly Carson she developed Relax into Yoga for Seniors, a gentle, research-informed way of adapting postures, breathing and meditation for older bodies, and the two of them co-direct a professional training through which well over a thousand yoga teachers have learned the approach. Before yoga became her main work she worked as a journalist: she launched The Washington Post's health pages as their first editor and wrote a syndicated column about exercise for twelve years.

Her teaching approaches yoga as a practice of awareness rather than simply exercise. Her book Yoga Sparks offers 108 tiny practices of a minute or less, drawing on postures, breath, meditation and yogic ethics, to bring calm into ordinary moments, and Yoga Shalom joins yoga with Jewish prayer and worship. Her YouTube channel shares gentle practices for relaxation, breathing, balance and waking up the body, some of them simple enough to do at the kitchen counter. She sees private clients at Duke Integrative Medicine in Durham, North Carolina, and online, and she holds a second-degree black belt in karate.

books.title: Yoga Sparks: 108 Easy Practices for Stress Relief in a Minute or Less
books.author: Carol Krucoff
books.description: A collection of very short yoga practices, each taking a minute or less and needing no mat, built on postures, breathing, meditation and yogic ethical principles. It aims to weave moments of awareness and calm into an ordinary day.

books.title: Relax into Yoga for Seniors
books.author: Carol Krucoff and Kimberly Carson
books.description: A six-week home programme of gentle yoga for older adults, working on strength, balance and flexibility alongside breathing and relaxation. Co-written with Kimberly Carson.

books.title: Yoga Shalom
books.author: Carol Krucoff
books.description: A book that brings yoga practice together with Jewish prayer, presenting a form of worship that involves body, breath and spirit.

books.title: Healing Yoga for Neck and Shoulder Pain
books.author: Carol Krucoff
books.description: Simple yoga practices for releasing tension held in the neck and shoulders and easing discomfort there, suitable for practising at home.

free_resources.title: Yoga Practice to Relieve Back and Neck Pain
free_resources.description: A free twenty-minute gentle yoga session she leads on video, easing tension in the back and neck. It was filmed for Duke Integrative Medicine and is shared on her site.

free_resources.title: Free Relaxation Breathing MP3
free_resources.description: A six-minute guided yoga breathing practice for stress relief, sent as a free audio download when you join her newsletter.
